briefdescription.para: Returns range shifted by fraction of its extent; a positive fraction raises both bounds.

detaileddescription.para: With logarithmic set, the shift is applied in log10 space, so both bounds are scaled by the same ratio. A range that is not positive is shifted linearly instead. memberdef.name: zoomedRange

briefdescription.para: Returns range with its extent multiplied by factor, keeping the value at anchorRatio in place.

detaileddescription.para: anchorRatio is a position inside the range: 0 at min and 1 at max. With logarithmic set, the extent is measured in log10 space. A range that is not positive is zoomed linearly instead. Returns range unchanged when a bound would leave the range of a double: it would not be finite, or in log10 space it would reach zero. Also returns range unchanged when a zoom-in would shrink the extent below 1e-12 of the larger bound, where double precision would soon collapse the bounds and keep a zoom-out from moving them.

briefdescription.para: Returns the extent multiplier for mouse-wheel zoom with a zoomScaleFactor in (0, 1).

detaileddescription.para: Zooming in multiplies the extent by the factor and zooming out by its reciprocal. A factor of 0 or below counts as 0.01 and a factor of 1 or above as 0.99, so a step always zooms and never collapses the range. Fractional step counts scale partial wheel notches proportionally.
